title: Version picker: releases listed, Pre-release tagged, what does not fit disabled
covers: Version select in the details dialog, install by tag, Update
context: The full details dialog of an Archipelia ready or Archipelago index world has a Version field. It lists the releases newest first, tags a Pre-release, and shows a release that does not fit the engine greyed out with the reason. The main button takes the newest stable release that fits. Only the dialog loads the list, never the Games page.
changed: packages/catalog versions: releases list with ETag cache, compatibility check against the active engine, install by tag
packages/design GameDetails: the Version field; views/GameStore useVersionPick
Update compares the installed version with the newest stable only

setup.label: launch
setup.text: The bundle-4 launch above. If the welcome tour opens by itself, press Skip.

setup.label: network
setup.text: Needed. The release list is read from GitHub when the dialog opens.

setup.label: engine
setup.text: Ready (the Engine page under App shows Ready).

setup.label: world
setup.text: A world with more than one release. Relic of the Past or any Archipelia ready world with several releases. A world with a Pre-release or an incompatible release shows step 4; without one, skip that part.

steps: Open Library, Games, tab Built-in and press the title of any world. The dialog has no Version field, because a built-in world ships with the engine. Close it.
Press the title of a world with several releases (tab Archipelia ready or Archipelago index). A field named Version appears. It reads Reading the versions for a moment.
Open the Version list. Releases run newest first. The newest stable release that fits is selected and noted Latest stable. An installed release is noted Installed.
A release marked as a pre-release carries the tag Pre-release. A release your engine cannot run is greyed out with a reason such as Needs Archipelago 0.6.4 or newer, and you cannot pick it.
With the default selected, press the main button (Add, or Update when installed). It installs the newest stable release, the same one the card button installs.
Pick an older release that fits. The main button reads Install this version (or Add). Press it. That release installs and a toast names its version.
Reopen the dialog. The note Installed sits on the release you chose. If it is older than the newest stable one, the card offers Update. Press Update: the world moves to the newest stable release.
pass: The Version field shows in the dialog of a listed or index world, never for a built-in world, and not on the Games page.
The default is the newest stable release that fits. Pre-release is tagged and a release that does not fit is disabled with a reason.
Install this version installs the chosen release, and Update goes to the newest stable one.
fail: The field shows for a built-in world, or the Games page reads the releases.
A release that does not fit can be installed, or is disabled with no reason.
The main button installs another release than the one selected, or a pre-release newer than every stable one shows Update.
notes: For Archipelago index worlds the list comes from the index and has no pre-release flag. Whether a release fits is checked at install.
GitHub may ask Archipelia to wait. The dialog then says so in a sentence, and the list from the cache stays.
Remove the world afterwards if you do not want it.
